_README: Rename this file to code-matrix.json to activate. Keys are 4-letter Skin Codes (O/D + S/R + P/N + W/T). Values list product HANDLES per step. Codes you don't list — and handles that don't exist in the catalog — fall back to the automatic ingredient engine, so a partial table is fine. 'name'/'tagline' optionally override the persona shown to the customer.

OSPT.name: The Glow Guardian
OSPT.tagline: Oily, easily flushed, and tone-focused — barrier first, brightening second.
